mutant.description: Two mutants, each applied with the Edit tool directly to the tracked file, run against the one criterion each targets, then reverted (confirmed by an empty `git diff --stat`) before the next test ran. M1: catalog.py membership_findings, the per-object master check (`if key_master != master:`) short-circuited to `if False and ...`. M2: aws_roles.py role_configs, the ExternalId-reuse refusal short-circuited the same way.
mutant.expected: M1 turns OGK1-AC7's 'another master' arm from rejected to something else. M2 turns OGK1-AC1's 'one ExternalId reused' refusal arm from raising RoleConfigError to not raising.
mutant.observed: M1: test_ogk1_ac07 FAILED -- AssertionError: assert 'incomplete' == 'rejected'. M2: test_ogk1_ac01 FAILED -- Failed: DID NOT RAISE <class 'app.integrations.schwab.aws_roles.RoleConfigError'>. Both reverted; test_ogk1_ac07 returned to '1 passed in 2.81s' and test_ogk1_ac01 to '1 passed in 2.26s'; git diff --stat on both files returned empty after each revert. (A first M1 attempt mutated the marker/closure-level master check in the same function and stayed GREEN -- the per-object key-parse check independently catches this fixture's arm, a real redundancy; recorded in catalog.result.md rather than discarded.)

determinism.method: Every one of the 17 criteria ran once standalone (one selected test per pytest invocation, per this order's own <invocation>), and the whole module ran together in one process after both mutants were reverted.
determinism.observed: 17 of 17 standalone runs: '1 passed' each, rc=0 (table in catalog.result.md). Full module together, post-revert: '17 passed in 24.25s' -- no new failure, matching the 17 individual passes. AC8/AC9 depend on moto's own conditional-write semantics, not wall-clock timing; AC11/AC14/AC15's window and staleness arithmetic run off the fixture's fixed CLOCK constant, not the real clock.
